title: Frontend: AI pathway display panel for parking lot items
description: Dedicated pathway display component that renders AI-generated implementation steps in a formatted, readable way.
acceptanceCriteria: Pathway displayed as formatted markdown (numbered list)

steps.details: Create src/components/project/AiPathwayPanel.tsx. Props: itemId, projectId, existingPathway? Renders: loading state, error state, or markdown content via ReactMarkdown. 'Regenerate' button calls the API again and updates.
Copy icon button that calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(pathway). Show 'Copied!' toast on success.
Generate pathway — verify markdown renders with numbered steps. Click copy — verify content is in clipboard. Click Regenerate — verify new pathway is fetched.
